name: Joshua Rotenberg
role: Senior Implementation Consultant - Enterprise AI Delivery
body: "AI doesn't just assist, it executes" is the exact thesis I've been building my company around. As founder of Solenzo, I design and deploy autonomous, agentic AI workflows that automate complex business logic and solve real business problems for B2B clients — so leading AI transformation projects on the monday.com platform reads less like a career change than a continuation of my current work. I'm also in the Denver metro for the hybrid role.

I bring the implementation-consulting foundation this role requires alongside the AI fluency. At Accelo I sold, scoped, and guided implementations of complex CRM and project-management software — owning onboarding, workflow design, relational data structures, and API integrations while building credibility with both technical and C-suite stakeholders. At Birdeye I led onboarding and configuration for a high-volume customer base and represented the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering. At Wix I managed and mentored a team of onboarding specialists, delivering a high-value portfolio on time and driving a 30% lift in traffic and 25% improvement in conversion in the e-commerce segment. Across all of it, I translate complex technical concepts into language executives and end users can act on.

What I'd add to your Professional Services practice is a consultant who already lives in the generative and agentic AI tooling, thinks in systems, and leads from a self-starter, lead-through-ambiguity mindset — exactly the standard you want set for junior consultants. I'd be glad to walk through how I'd approach AI-first solution design for your Enterprise customers. Thank you for your consideration.
